# Setup a Python virtual environment (with Pwntools installed)

Refer to the "virtual-env" notes under the "Cheatsheet" section to download the notes on how to setup a virtual environment

# Connect to the remote challenge server

Open a terminal:

> $ -> indicates a single line of command (omit this symbol in your commands)

Run the command: `nc cloud.chals.io 23`, and enter the value "sentctf-lockeddown.chals.io" when prompted for the host

```
$ nc cloud.chals.io 23
Host: sentctf-lockeddown.chals.io
```
